description: This file defines the 'ShellScope' class, which manages shell state, dependency injection scopes, and execution flow within the OrchardCore framework. It includes methods for scope creation, disposal, tenant activation, deferred tasks, and exception handling.

classes.name: ShellScope
classes.description: Manages shell lifecycle, dependency scopes, tenant activation, deferred tasks, signals, and exception handling within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ShellScope
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shell scope with a parent 'ShellContext'.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a shared item in the current shell scope.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a shared item from the current shell scope.

methods.name: Get<T>
methods.description: Retrieves a typed shared item from the current shell scope.

methods.name: GetOrCreate<T>
methods.description: Gets or creates a shared item of type T in the current shell scope.

methods.name: SetFeature
methods.description: Sets a shared feature in the current shell scope.

methods.name: GetFeature
methods.description: Gets a shared feature from the current shell scope.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFeature
methods.description: Gets or creates a shared feature of type T in the current shell scope.

methods.name: CreateChildScopeAsync
methods.description: Creates a new child shell scope asynchronously.

methods.name: UsingChildScopeAsync
methods.description: Executes a delegate within a new child scope.

methods.name: StartAsyncFlow
methods.description: Begins tracking the current scope in the async flow.

methods.name: UsingServiceScopeAsync
methods.description: Executes a delegate within a service-only scope.

methods.name: UsingAsync
methods.description: Executes a delegate within this shell scope, managing activation and disposal.

methods.name: TerminateShellAsync
methods.description: Terminates the shell associated with this scope.

methods.name: RegisterBeforeDispose
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked before scope disposal.

methods.name: AddDeferredSignal
methods.description: Adds a signal to be sent after scope disposal.

methods.name: AddDeferredTask
methods.description: Adds a deferred task to run after scope disposal.

methods.name: AddExceptionHandler
methods.description: Registers an exception handler for this scope.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Executes all registered exception handlers.

methods.name: BeforeDisposeAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions, signals, and deferred tasks before scope disposal.

methods.name: TerminateShellInternalAsync
methods.description: Handles shell termination logic, including event invocation.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the scope synchronously.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes the scope asynchronously.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Clears the current scope from async local storage.

methods.name: ThrowIfTerminating
methods.description: Throws if the scope is already terminating.
